```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

set.seed(123)
options(digits = 3, scipen = 999)

```

```{r load-libraries}
library(rmdformats)
library(clarify)
library(AER)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(pscl)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r load-data, include = FALSE}
setwd("C:/Users/Yung Cho/Documents/GitHub/Yung_QC")
bc_data <- read.csv("NYCDCP_Manhattan_Bike_Counts_-_On_Street_Weekday_20250320.csv")

str(bc_data)

```

```{r data-wrangling}
colSums(is.na(bc_data))

bc_data[is.na(bc_data)] <- 0

sum(is.na(bc_data))

```

```{r 1st model glm}
pm1 <- glm(Citibike_All ~ CycBikeLane,
           family = poisson, data = bc_data)
summary(pm1)

```

```{r Model 1 AME}
sim_coefs1 <- sim(pm1)
im_est1 <- sim_ame(sim_coefs1, var = "CycBikeLane",
                    contrast = "rd")
summary(sim_est1)

```

```{r 2nd glm}
pm2 <- glm(Citibike_All ~ CycBikeLane + Cycl_Helmet_all,
           family = poisson, data = bc_data)

summary(pm2)

```

```{r Model 2 AME effect of bike lanes}
sim_coefs2 <- sim(pm2)
sim_est2 <- sim_ame(sim_coefs2, var = "CycBikeLane",
                    contrast = "rd")
summary(sim_est2)
```
```{r Model 2a AME effect of helmets}
sim_est2a <- sim_ame(sim_coefs2, var = "Cycl_Helmet_all",
                    contrast = "rd")
summary(sim_est2a)
```
```{r adrf:prediction}
sim_est2b <- sim_adrf(sim_coefs2, var = "CycBikeLane",
                      contrast = "adrf")
plot(sim_est2b)

# The sudden increase after a long flat strongly suggest the presence of excess zero values.
```

```{r check for zeros}
ggplot(bc_data, aes(x = Citibike_All)) + geom_histogram()
```
```{r zero-inflated poisson regression}
pm4 <- pscl::zeroinfl(Citibike_All ~ CycBikeLane + Cycl_Helmet_all
                      | 1, data = bc_data, dist = "poisson")
summary(pm4)
```
```{r}
# Manually supply the covariance matrix
sim_coefs4 <- sim(pm4, vcov = vcov(pm4))

# Proceed with the Average Marginal Effects (AME) calculation
sim_est4 <- sim_ame(sim_coefs4, var = "Cycl_Helmet_all",
                    contrast = "rd")

# Summarize the results
summary(sim_est4)
```
